title: Banana Bread
description: Like Nan used to make — moist, forgiving, and quietly better than it has any right to be.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 175°C. Grease and line a loaf tin.
In a large bowl, mix mashed bananas, melted butter, brown sugar, egg, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Sprinkle over bi-carb soda and salt, then gently fold in plain flour until just combined.
Fold through walnuts, taking care not to overmix.
Pour batter into prepared 23 cm loaf tin and smooth the top.
Bake for 50–60 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Slice thick, toast lightly, and spread with butter while still warm.

notes.title: Variations
notes.content: Walnuts can be replaced with dark chocolate chips or omitted entirely for a plain loaf.

notes.title: Portioning Guide
notes.content: Cuts cleanly into 9 slices at approximately 25 mm thick. For thinner slices, slice at 20 mm for up to 12 serves.
